**Continuous 2.38.6**, a community-maintained fork of the Continue VS Code extension. Continuous is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or supported by Continue Dev, Inc.

It installs alongside the original extension (its ID is `b1tninja.continuous`), brings your existing `~/.continue` configuration with it, and collects no telemetry. To update from 2.38.5, 2.38.4, 2.38.3, 2.38.2, 2.38.1, 2.38.0, 2.36.0, 2.34.0, 2.32.0, 2.30.0, 2.28.0, 2.26.0, 2.24.0, 2.22.0, 2.20.0, 2.18.0, 2.16.3, 2.16.2, 2.16.1, 2.16.0, 2.14.0, 2.12.x, 2.10.x or 2.4.x, install the new `.vsix` the same way, or let the Marketplace update it. Coming from 2.4.1 or earlier, also see [Continued is now Continuous](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/tag/v2.4.2-vscode) in the 2.4.2 notes: the extension ID changed.

## Install

1. Download the `.vsix` for your platform below and, optionally, check it against `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
2. Run `code --install-extension continuous-<platform>-2.38.6.vsix --force`, or in VS Code use the Extensions view: `...` → **Install from VSIX…**, then reload the window.

Requires VS Code 1.105 or newer. The packages are not code-signed. Full instructions: [install guide](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/blob/main/docs/continuous-install.md). Continuous is also on the VS Code Marketplace as **Continuous** (`b1tninja.continuous`).

| Platform                    | File                                                                       |
| --------------------------- | -------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Windows x64 / Arm64         | `continuous-win32-x64-2.38.6.vsix`, `continuous-win32-arm64-2.38.6.vsix`   |
| macOS Apple Silicon / Intel | `continuous-darwin-arm64-2.38.6.vsix`, `continuous-darwin-x64-2.38.6.vsix` |
| Linux x64 / Arm64           | `continuous-linux-x64-2.38.6.vsix`, `continuous-linux-arm64-2.38.6.vsix`   |

Each platform also has an **agents** build, `continuous-<platform>-2.38.6-agents.vsix`. It adds Continuous to VS Code's Agents window through APIs that are still proposed, so it works in VS Code Insiders, or in Stable started with `code --enable-proposed-api b1tninja.continuous`. Without that it works like the normal build. See [VS Code Chat and Agents](https://b1tninja.github.io/continuous/customize/vscode-chat-and-agents).

## The CLI

The terminal agent is attached as `continuous-cli-2.38.6.tgz`. Install it on Node 22 or newer:

```sh
npm i -g https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/releases/download/v2.38.6-vscode/continuous-cli-2.38.6.tgz
```

The package is `@b1tninja/continuous-cli` and the command is `continuous` (`continuous serve` is the headless server; the notes below call it `cn serve` where the docs do). The short command `cn` also works; both run the same program. It reads the same `~/.continuous` configuration as the extension.

## What's new since 2.38.5

This release is mostly repairs. On Windows, `multi_edit` and `single_find_and_replace` failed on every call in 2.38.4 and 2.38.5, and they work again. A formula in a reply no longer takes the chat down. Restore to here can bring back files the agent edited. A colour theme the extension cannot read no longer stops the sidebar from loading. A turn ends when the model goes silent instead of showing "Generating…" for up to two hours.

No new host is contacted by the extension or the terminal agent.

### New

- **Silent model.** A turn ends when the model sends nothing for 120 seconds after the reply has started, or for 10 minutes before the first text. A server you run yourself gets 5 and 30 minutes. The message says how long the model was silent, what arrived is kept, and Resume is offered. The terminal agent does not have this yet.
- **Maths in chat.** `$$…$$` is typeset as a display formula. `$…$` on one line is typeset as an inline formula.

### Behaviour changes

- **Dollar signs.** Two `$` on the same line now read as an inline formula, so "from $5 to $10" can be typeset as maths. A single `$` is left alone. A setting for this is planned.
- **Command output.** The model reads command output without terminal colour codes. The chat still shows the colours.
- **Audit.** A command ended by its time limit or by a stop records how it ended. "Timed out" now means the time limit only, not a stop you asked for.

### Fixes

- **Editing on Windows.** `multi_edit` and `single_find_and_replace` failed with "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'relative')" on every call. They work again.
- **Restore to here.** A checkpoint recorded every file the agent edited as unreadable, so a restore could only delete files the agent had created. Edited files are saved again and can be restored. Checkpoints taken before this release stay as they are. Files that hold secrets are still not copied.
- **Formulas.** A reply with a KaTeX formula stopped the chat with "Minified React error #62" ([#988](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/issues/988)). Thanks to the author of [#989](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/pull/989).
- **Colour themes.** A theme file with a trailing comma or a block comment left the sidebar showing "An error occurred while loading view" ([#981](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/issues/981)). Such files are read now, and a theme that still cannot be read no longer stops the page.
- **Narrow sidebar.** The model setup form was cut off on both sides in a sidebar narrower than about 390 pixels ([#982](https://github.com/b1tninja/continuous/issues/982)). It fits down to 250.
- **Diagrams and code blocks.** A mermaid block was shown as code instead of a diagram, and the code block toolbar did not know the language.
- **Steer now.** Steering a turn that had only started thinking removed the message the model was answering. The message stays.
- **Error text.** When a message cannot be drawn, the error text wraps instead of running off the side.
- **Accept and Reject.** Both buttons keep a name for screen readers when the sidebar is too narrow to show their labels.
